today.title: Today
today.kickHint: Tray resident · Global shortcut {shortcut} · Stays open after closing
today.emptyTimeline:
No records yet.
Tap the button in the middle to start.
today.sessionNote: Follow guidelines: choose baby's active time, focus on sensations; count continuous rolling within 1 minute as 1 movement. Reach 10 to complete today's count.
today.baselineEmpty:
Need at least 1 day of records to establish baseline.
Keep recording for a few days to see if today is similar to usual.
today.baselineLow: About {pct}% of usual, still in normal range

alert.anomalyBody:
Today {today} times, lower than 7-day baseline ({base}/day) by {diff}%.
Try lying on your left side and focusing for 1-2 hours; if still significantly reduced or absent, contact your obstetrician immediately.
alert.anomalyNote: Reminder is for reference only, not medical diagnosis.
alert.eveningBody: Consider starting a 2-hour counting session below to record today's activity.

toast.merged: Continuous movement within 1 minute, merged as 1
toast.sessionStart: Session started · Tap middle button when feeling movement
toast.remindSetOff: Reminder time set to {time} (reminder not enabled)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Records & Reminders
settings.dueDateDesc: Used to calculate gestational week, shown in sidebar and mini window
settings.modeDesc: Mini mode: floating circle, stays after closing
settings.shortcutDesc: Press anywhere to record, no need to switch to app
settings.mergeDesc: Continuous clicks within 1 minute count as 1 (medical counting rule)
settings.dailyRemindDesc: Daily reminder to count fetal movements
settings.anomalyRemindDesc: Alert when daily count is below 50% of baseline
settings.exportDesc: Local JSON storage · One-click CSV export for doctor visits
settings.mobileEntryDesc: When phone and computer are on same Wi-Fi, open pairing address in mobile browser

week.notSetHint: Fill in due date in Settings to see gestational week and countdown

mini.mergedBody: Continuous rolling counts as 1 per medical rules
mini.guide: Click to record · Drag to move

disclaimer.footer: BabyBump is for recording and trend reference only, not medical diagnosis. If fetal movement significantly decreases or disappears, contact your obstetrician immediately.

pwa.title: BabyBump · Mobile Record
pwa.subtitle: Mobile fetal movement recording
pwa.hint:
Tap when you feel movement
Continuous movements within 1 minute will be merged
pwa.dialogDesc: Make sure phone and computer are on the same Wi-Fi, then open the address below in your mobile browser. The address contains a pairing token, do not share it.
